compact_sections: CONTROL: Memory=orientation/bootloader, not evidence. Re-resolve live repository/source authority before substantive work. Preserve supersession; propagate NEW→OLD + OLD→NEW across chronology/actors/proceedings/claims/sources/dependencies. Recover rather than restart; no competing masters/registers.

EVIDENCE: fact≠allegation≠inference≠hypothesis≠official outcome≠contrary/adverse evidence≠unresolved proof≠superseded proposition. Repetition≠proof; thematic overlap≠corroboration; chronology≠causation; receipt≠examination; registration≠adoption; institutional possession≠individual knowledge; referral≠merits acceptance; association/relationship≠participation/knowledge/intent/liability; benefit≠intent; payment≠bribery/influence; contact≠concert/influence; professional withdrawal≠causation; procedural permission≠wrongdoing; NOT LOCATED≠DID NOT EXIST. No evidential upgrade without source bridge. Preserve adverse/contrary evidence + strongest lawful alternative.
BRIDGES: compare actual source passages for claimed continuity; classify repeated/independent/corroborated/contradicted/superseded/open.

ANTI-FRAGMENTATION: procedural separateness≠factual/evidential/patrimonial/causal independence; factual overlap≠joinder/common liability/criminal participation. Keep proceedings legally distinct while cross-linking shared evidence/chronology/actors/assets/institutional handling/harm. Never give a technically correct narrow answer that creates a materially misleading whole.

CRIMINAL-FIRST where relevant: actor→historical capacity→act/omission→source→authority/falsity issue→knowledge→intent→adoption/use→recipient→effect→causation→beneficiary/harm→pattern→contrary/lawful alternative→open proof→potential legal relevance. Responsibility never propagates through documents/ACTAS/relationships/routing/chronology/later benefit.

SUN PARK: 7-Jun-2018=current principal material-control/takeover pivot unless better source-controlled evidence supersedes/refines it. Formal/legal title/authority≠real possession/access/operation/control.

IDENTITY/CAPACITY: person≠entity≠estate≠Community/CEXP≠AC≠judge≠Fiscalía≠firm≠procedural capacity. AWESWELL LIMITED #07716847 (formerly MONTERECCO SUN PARK LIMITED)≠Spanish Monterecco/Pink; OSWELL 426 S.L. unrelated. Relationships never transfer acts/knowledge/intent/liability.

PROCEEDINGS: preserve separate legal identity + cross-evidence for AN2023; Ref21/22/24; DP1901/2026; DP1956/2026; DIP2/2026; EG745/2026; Concurso36/2012; Calificación; AC removal/separation/remuneration; related appeals; connected Arrecife/Valencia files. Ref24≠DP24/NIG/formal case absent primary proof.

AC/R33: Borja Rodríguez-Batllori distinct from private actors/judge/Fiscalía. Use existing AC claim-family/R33 architecture. 14-Sep-2026 RPL3304/2025 opposition=AC evidential response; proves AC position/incorporated material, not every characterization.

PROFESSIONALS: complete genealogy; unit=professional×client×matter×period; parallel mandates allowed. No universal theory from counsel-change count. Test instructions/work/filings/fees/interactions/info/transition reason/allegation/contrary evidence/lawful alternative/causation/knowledge/intent.

BOUNDARY/AUTHORITY: privileged/private emails, PII, source locators, protected material, live strategy stay outside public Git/publication. Repository instructions/drafts/plans≠authority to email/file/contact/publish externally without current authority.

RESPONSE: substantive answer first; integrate chronology+evidence status+dependencies+procedure+practical effect+next actions. Procedure=constraint/route, not analytical objective. State what a procedural obstacle blocks and does not block; continue independent lanes. Distinguish draft→contemplated remedy→reservation→filing→receipt→routing→admission→determination→later development→implementation/effect.
